description.value: Meat & Bread is a beloved Vancouver sandwich chain built around a small, focused menu of chef-crafted sandwiches anchored by their signature porchetta, carved fresh to order from whole-roasted pork. The West Broadway location also serves breakfast sandwiches and sides, making it a versatile stop for cyclists on the busy Broadway corridor. The interior is wheelchair accessible and offers indoor seating.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active multi-location sandwich chain with the Broadway location at 796 West Broadway, Vancouver, matching the OSM address. The Broadway menu page explicitly lists 'ORDER PICKUP' and 'ORDER DELIVERY' and includes several vegetarian options (Two Egg Veg, Grilled Cheese, Eggplant Parmesan). No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears in either the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 11:00-16:00) appears outdated; Broadway menu page shows Mon-Fri 8AM-8PM and Weekends 11AM-4PM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Meat & Bread is a well-established, cyclist-friendly food stop on a major Vancouver cycling corridor, but the required bike parking or visibility criterion cannot be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct confirmation of bike parking would likely support inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is one of four Vancouver locations; OSM record is specifically for the Broadway (796 West Broadway) shop.
